repos.name: Pulse-Echo Azimuthal Scanner
repos.blurb: Ultrasonic instrument measuring the crystal orientation fabric of ice cores. Custom RP2040 controller board, sensorless homing and force-controlled docking, Streamlit control app, and a full machine manual.

repos.name: Pulse-Echo Azimuthal Simulation
repos.blurb: The scanner's digital twin. Anisotropic GPU FDTD validated against an independent finite-element solver, an acquisition error model, and fabric inversion.

repos.name: OpenUSCT
repos.blurb: Open-source ultrasound computed tomography. Full-waveform inversion in Python, C++ and GPU, FPGA acquisition in SystemVerilog, and a browser studio.

repos.name: Ice CNC Ultrasound
repos.blurb: Five-axis pitch-catch ultrasonic core scanner. Marlin-based motion, load-cell coupling interlock, Python acquisition stack. Built for the PhD.

repos.name: Fabric Analyser
repos.blurb: Machine-vision instrument for crystal-orientation measurement in ice-core thin sections. RP2350 firmware, Python and OpenCV, KiCad hardware.

repos.name: Yertle
repos.blurb: 3D-printed quadruped robot for locomotion research, on ROS.

repos.name: Meowtion
repos.blurb: Smart cat collar that spots illness early by watching habits. On-device AI over a confidence-gated cascade, nRF52840 collar on Zephyr, ESP32-S3 base station, cloud training and a live dashboard.

repos.name: BugBot
repos.blurb: Holonomic X-omni robot for teaching AI and engineering at 16 to 19. ESP32-S3 firmware and a web control UI.

repos.name: R&D Prep
repos.blurb: Interactive refresher for R&D and embedded interviews. Lessons, a question bank and code drills that are compiled and run for real by GCC. One static page, no framework and no build step.

repos.name: The Coding Industry
repos.blurb: White paper on product coding and marking in manufacturing, arguing that laser displaces ink on cost structure rather than on print quality. XeLaTeX.
